latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Movie Maker Game Free — Turn Game Clips Into Movies.

- Upload game clips or images up to 500MB and turn them into a shareable movie with music and transitions.
- Fast cloud processing (about 1–2 minutes per video) delivers 1080p MP4 output.
- Automatic session setup with free credits — just upload files and describe what you want.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (video), plus JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP (images), and major audio formats.
- Handy commands for export, checking credits, status, or managing your timeline.
- Designed for casual gamers and creators; works without registration.
